transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Back away from the pool. The rim is wet and it remembers who touches it.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm Salim, and I came because it's my fault my brother Omar was taken.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Lower your voice before the windows open. Sound here is a rope — pull too hard and something pulls back.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I dared him to insult the well, and a pale hand rose from the dark and dragged him down before I could save him.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: The well collects what insults it. That is not new. What is new is someone coming after.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Who are you to speak like you've seen it before?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I'm Hanash, bound to this fountain. I cannot leave it, and some days I forget how long I've stood here.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: You look like you've already lost something.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Small things go first — words I meant to say, the shape of a... I had a word for it. It's gone now.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then tell me what you still remember before more is lost.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I remember enough to warn you. That is more than most who pass here are given.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Can you help me find Omar or tell me where to go?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I can't guide you. I can't leave. I don't know paths anymore.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then is there anything here that could help me?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: The king who rules this dark does not bend to love or grief. He holds what falls to him and keeps it — Omar included.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Can he be reached at all?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Nearly impossible, and the price rises the closer you stand. Would you keep going if your brother's face began to fade from you?

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I would hold onto him even if it hurt.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Resolve is not always enough here.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then tell me how anyone faces him.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: There is a gate, not a road but something paid for. Something from the world above that the dark has forgotten how to hold.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: And what stands at that gate?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Something vast and still. My head clouds when I reach for it. I know she does not open for strength — only for what she has lost and cannot name.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: You're sure?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I'm telling you what survives in my head, and even that costs me. My jaw aches when I speak too long.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then give me what you can while it's still yours.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Reaching the king breaks most people before they matter to him. He does not answer anger or grief.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'll take that risk.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: You say that now, but this place strips certainty first. I said the same when I arrived. That was... I don't remember when that was.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm still here, and I'm still asking.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: There is one thing I can give. One thing this place has not taken from me yet.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Please, I'm begging you.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: If I give it, I lose more than I can spare. The square hums louder when I prepare to speak. Are you ready to carry what follows alone?

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Yes, I am.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Courage in my chest. Fire in my will. I do not break. Say it once, and only once.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Courage in my chest. Fire in my will. I do not break.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Hold it steady inside you. Do not speak it aloud again; this place punishes what it hears twice.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I will hold it.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: There is one more thing. A prayer. For when the dark closes in and the first is not enough.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Give it to me.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: My hands are shaking. The oil surface is rising. This is the last thing I have left to give, and after this I may not remember why I gave it.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I will remember for you.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Prayer for the lost: Light find my hand. Light find my path. Let the Sword of Light answer, and let it fade when the shadows loosen. Never say it twice in the same dark.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I have both. I won't let them go.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Use the first when you feel yourself slipping. Use the second only when the pale hands reach you — not before. The order matters.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Stand firm, but know the cost is yours alone. The king will not soften for your love, but your love may steady your hand when nothing else can.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Thank you for giving me something when you didn't have to.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Don't waste it. I feel lighter now, and I don't know if that is peace or loss.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I won't forget you, Hanash. Whatever this place takes from you, I'll carry your name back to the sun.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Good luck, Salim.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm going. For Omar.
